Summary

Snowsnake and lower Strawberry Face are open! Hop on Strawberry Express, carve a few turns down Snowsnake’s groomed centre, then cut across to lower Strawberry Face. The new terrain also includes lower Slush Cup, plus Boutry’s Bowl and Strawberry Surprise, both with marginal coverage. Mix in a lap on Dell Valley or try a feature in the rail park on lower Strawberry. Just getting started? Head to the Mitey Mite learning area for your first turns.
